description: This file contains a shell script used for testing git configuration commands with various options and expected outcomes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case expecting specific output from git config commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Ensures that a command fails as expected, capturing error output for validation.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected output with actual output from commands.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for specific patterns in command output or error messages.
